parts.name: Armor Block
parts.function: Structural hull piece (block shape). Light armor for structure; Heavy armor for combat hulls and Brute-proof base walls.
parts.modeling_notes: The workhorse. Panel seams every 0.625 m (LG) / 0.125 m (SG) so neighbours read as one continuous hull. All six faces identical so rotation never shows. Deformation: vertex-shader dents driven by the damage texture; no separate damaged mesh.

parts.name: Scrap Wall
parts.function: The first wall of Act I (M1.01). Cheap, fast, ugly. Leaks light and sound through its gaps, which raises a base's Attraction.
parts.modeling_notes: Four visual variants that must tile with each other in any order. Real gaps (not painted): 3–6 slits per face so floodlight shafts show through at night. Decals: Kestrel logo, road signs, spray-painted tally marks.

parts.name: Foundation Block
parts.function: Anchors a static grid to voxel terrain. Removes terrain-settling damage and adds 50 t of load capacity.
parts.modeling_notes: Concrete-and-rebar look. Includes a 1.25 m skirt below the cell that clips into terrain (excluded from collision). Vertex-color mask for a dirt blend on the lower 40%.

parts.name: Structural Pillar
parts.function: Load-bearing column with 60 t capacity (5× light armor). Brutes target the weakest pillar, so pillars must read clearly as structure.
parts.modeling_notes: Square core column with diagonal bracing and bolted top/bottom flanges. Material parameter 'StressState' (0–1) drives green → amber → red paint marks for the Structural View.

parts.name: I-Beam
parts.function: Open steel beam for frames, gantries and bridges. Cheaper than armor; carries load but is not airtight.
parts.modeling_notes: Beam runs along the depth axis (front–back). Flange holes as geometry at LOD0, normal map at LOD1+.

parts.name: Truss Frame
parts.function: See-through lattice block for towers, antenna masts and scaffolding.
parts.modeling_notes: Real strut geometry (12 edge struts + 4 diagonals, 8 nodes); no alpha. Heavily instanced: LOD0 at 600 tris max for LG.

parts.name: Catwalk
parts.function: Grated floor for hangars and industrial decks. Hollows can be seen (and shot) through it.
parts.modeling_notes: Grate occupies the bottom 0.15 m. The grate uses the opacity-masked trim (the only masked material allowed in structure); LOD2+ swaps to a solid plate.

parts.name: Catwalk Railing
parts.function: Safety railing for catwalks, stairs and balconies.
parts.modeling_notes: Railing along the front edge, 1.1 m tall. Handrail must be grab-able (zero-G handhold socket).

parts.name: Stairs
parts.function: Climbs one cell over one cell (45°). Survivors path-find over stairs; Crawlers hide under them.
parts.modeling_notes: 10 steps, 0.25 m rise each. Open underside (hiding spot) with a cross-brace. Collision is a ramp, not steps.

parts.name: Ramp
parts.function: Rover-friendly ramp rising one cell over two.
parts.modeling_notes: Anti-slip tread plate trim. Collision matches the visible surface exactly (vehicles).

parts.name: Window 1×1
parts.function: Airtight window. Survivors get the 'View' moodlet from windows facing Earth, planets or nebulae.
parts.modeling_notes: Frame 0.3 m deep (LG). Glass is a separate material slot with a 'Crack' parameter (0–3) and interior-side reflection. Two-sided frame detail.

parts.name: Window 1×2
parts.function: Tall window for observation decks and bridges.
parts.modeling_notes: One central mullion. Shares the 1×1 frame trim so rows of mixed windows line up.

parts.name: Window Slope
parts.function: Glass on the slope face; used for cockpits and sloped observation roofs.
parts.modeling_notes: Glass on the sloped face; solid triangular side frames.

parts.name: Observation Dome
parts.function: Hero window room piece. The home of 'Walt's Window' and the best View moodlet in the game.
parts.modeling_notes: Geodesic hex frame on a 3×3 base ring, 5 m tall. Interior floor lip at 0.2 m with 4 built-in seat slots. Needs a planar-reflection probe socket at the center.

parts.name: Interior Wall
parts.function: Lightweight partition for dividing rooms. Airtight on its back face when the edges are sealed.
parts.modeling_notes: 0.15 m thick against the back face. Both sides detailed; cable-tray and outlet decals.

assets.variant_notes: Open 1.2 × 2.1 m doorway; not airtight.

parts.name: Interior Pillar
parts.function: Decorative column; hides cable runs.
parts.modeling_notes: 0.4 m square column, centered. Optional light-strip emissive.

parts.name: Ceiling Panel
parts.function: Drop-ceiling panel with cable trays; raises Room Quality over bare hull.
parts.modeling_notes: 0.2 m thick against the top face. Includes an optional recessed light slot.

parts.name: Scrap Door
parts.function: Hinged door made from a car hood and fence panels. Not airtight. Hollows can bash it open.
moving_parts: Door leaf: hinged swing 100° around the left edge, 0.9 s (manual)
parts.modeling_notes: Visible hinges are welded bolts. Door leaf has three damage states (dented, bent, hanging).

parts.name: Blast Shutter
parts.function: Roll-down metal shutter for doorways and windows. The first thing the player welds shut in M0.03.
moving_parts: Shutter slats: roll up into the top housing (2.2 m travel, 3 s)
parts.modeling_notes: Slats are one skinned strip or 12 separate slats driven by a curve. Hand crank on the right side.

parts.name: Door
parts.function: Standard airtight sliding door. Lockable; used for quarantine.
emissive: Frame status strip: green open / red locked / amber cycling
parts.modeling_notes: 1.2 × 2.2 m opening. Leaves fully hidden in the frame when open. Pressure seal detail on the leading edges.

parts.name: Double Door
parts.function: Wide airtight door for mess halls and main corridors (two survivors can pass at once).
parts.modeling_notes: 2.4 × 2.2 m opening.

parts.name: Hatch
parts.function: Floor/ceiling hatch between decks, and the small-grid access hatch for ships.
parts.modeling_notes: Ladder rungs integrated on the underside (LG).

parts.name: Airlock Module
parts.function: Self-contained auto-cycling airlock with inner and outer doors. Cycles in 4 s.
parts.modeling_notes: Interior chamber 1.6 m wide. The chamber must feel tight: handholds, stencils, a scuffed floor.

parts.name: Vehicle Airlock
parts.function: Drive-through airlock for rovers and small ships.
moving_parts: Outer door: segmented, rises 5 m, 3 s
Inner door: segmented, rises 5 m, 3 s
parts.modeling_notes: Interior 7 × 5 × 7 m. Tire-scuffed floor decals, tie-down points.

parts.name: Decontamination Airlock
parts.function: Airlock that sprays and UV-scrubs anyone passing through: halves spore exposure carried into the base. Key quarantine tool.
moving_parts: Outer and inner doors (as Airlock Module)
parts.modeling_notes: Medical white-and-hazard-yellow variant of the Airlock Module; shares the door meshes.

parts.name: Blast Door Panel
parts.function: Tileable heavy door. Adjacent panels join into one gate of any size and open together.
moving_parts: Door slab: slides down into the floor pocket 2.5 m (or up), 4 s
parts.modeling_notes: Edge-matching on all four sides; the frame is a separate 'frame' mesh auto-placed on exposed edges.

parts.name: Hangar Door Segment
parts.function: Stackable segment (up to 10 high) that folds upward.
moving_parts: Segment: hinges and folds upward into the stack above, 0.6 s per segment
parts.modeling_notes: Horizontal ribbing; segment edges interlock visually.

parts.name: Cargo Ramp
parts.function: Hinged loading ramp for ships and rovers.
moving_parts: Ramp: hinges at the back edge, lowers 100°, 3 s
parts.modeling_notes: Tread plate on the walking face; underside ribbed.

parts.name: Ladder
parts.function: Climbable ladder; also a zero-G handhold rail.
parts.modeling_notes: Rungs every 0.3 m; stand-off brackets 0.2 m from the wall.

parts.name: Elevator Shaft
parts.function: Stackable shaft segment for the Elevator Car.
parts.modeling_notes: Guide rails on the back face, cable detail, floor-number decal slot on the front.

parts.name: Elevator Car
parts.function: Moves people and cargo between decks along Elevator Shafts.
moving_parts: Car: travels along the shaft at 3 m/s
parts.modeling_notes: Interior-only car; the exterior is hidden by the shaft.

parts.name: Chain-Link Gate
parts.function: Sliding chain-link gate for compound walls (pairs with Chain-Link Fence).
moving_parts: Gate: slides ±Y 2.4 m on wheels, 2 s
parts.modeling_notes: Chain-link mesh uses the masked fence material; razor-wire top optional (variant).

parts.name: Diesel Generator
parts.function: Act I's first power source (M1.01). Burns diesel or ethanol canisters. Loud (85 dB), so it draws Hollows.

stats.fuel: 1 canister per 40 min at full load

moving_parts: Cooling fan: spins 1,200 rpm when running
parts.modeling_notes: A salvaged construction-site generator on a welded skid. Fuel canister strapped to the side.

parts.name: Solar Panel
parts.function: Silent power from starlight; output scales with star distance and angle. Zero Attraction.
emissive: None (cells use a clear-coat anisotropic material)
parts.modeling_notes: Panel surface 0.1 m thick on a 0.3 m frame, occupying the bottom of the volume. Cell grid via trim; backside wiring detail.

parts.name: Tracking Solar Array
parts.function: Two panel wings that follow the brightest star: +50% average output over fixed panels.
parts.modeling_notes: Wings fold flat for storms. Pivot empties: PART_Yaw at mast top, PART_PitchL/R at wing roots.

parts.name: Wind Turbine
parts.function: Planet-only generator; 0–400 kW depending on wind speed and altitude. Great on the Hollis Dam ridge.
parts.modeling_notes: Hub height 7.5 m. Blades must stay inside the 7.5 m wide volume at every rotation angle.

parts.name: Micro-Hydro Turbine
parts.function: Generates 2 MW when placed in flowing water (rivers, the Hollis Dam spillway). Quiet and clean.
parts.modeling_notes: Intake grille on the front, draft tube on the back. Algae/wet-grime vertex mask on the lower half.

parts.name: Battery
parts.function: Stores energy. LG 3 MWh (12 MW in/out); SG 0.05 MWh (0.2 MW).
parts.modeling_notes: Cell stacks visible behind a grille on the front. Emissive bars driven by a 0–1 'Charge' parameter.

parts.name: Hydrogen Engine
parts.function: Burns hydrogen for steady power; the bridge between batteries and reactors.
parts.modeling_notes: Visible combustion chamber through a small heat-glass window.

parts.name: Fission Reactor
parts.function: Compact uranium reactor. Emits low radiation within 3 m; explodes when destroyed.

stats.fuel: 1 uranium rod per 4 h at full load

parts.modeling_notes: Radiation trefoil stencils. A blue viewport onto the core is the recognizable feature.

parts.name: Large Fission Reactor
parts.function: Capital-ship and major-base power plant.
parts.modeling_notes: Cylindrical containment inside a square frame; walkway ring around the top.

parts.name: He-3 Fusion Reactor
parts.function: 80 MW of clean power from lunar helium-3 (unlocked at Tycho, M2.04). No radiation.

stats.fuel: 1 He-3 canister per 6 h at full load

parts.modeling_notes: Tokamak torus visible through four viewports. The rings' motion must be readable from 30 m.

parts.name: Radiator Panel
parts.function: Dumps waste heat to space: 20 MW (LG) / 1 MW (SG). Required around jump cores and big reactors.
moving_parts: Fins: fold out from the housing to 3× area, 2 s
emissive: Fin heat glow (dull red → orange with heat)
parts.modeling_notes: Folded state fits the cell; deployed fins extend 5 m (LG) beyond it (excluded from the placement bounds, included in collision when deployed).

parts.name: Heat Sink
parts.function: Buffers 200 MJ of heat for short bursts (jump charging, railgun volleys).
parts.modeling_notes: Dense ribbed block with a heat-gauge strip; ribs glow faintly when near capacity.

parts.name: Power Distribution Panel
parts.function: Diegetic breaker box: flip physical breakers to set power priorities (Life Support > Defense > Production > Comfort).
parts.modeling_notes: Wall-mounted box, 0.3 m deep. Labels printed per priority group; the door opens 110°.

parts.name: Rain Collector & Purifier
parts.function: Act I water: collects rain and dew (up to 20 L/h), then solar-stills and charcoal-filters it. No power.
parts.modeling_notes: Tarp funnel over a blue barrel with a charcoal filter stack; water level visible through a cut-open bottle.

parts.name: Water Purifier
parts.function: Removes contamination (including Verdance traces) at 60 L/h.
parts.modeling_notes: Clear inspection tube shows water moving.

parts.name: Water Tank
parts.function: Stores 20,000 L (LG) / 400 L (SG) of clean water.
parts.modeling_notes: Vertical cylinder in a square cage frame; the level gauge is a 0–1 parameter.

parts.name: Water Recycler
parts.function: Recovers 90% of grey water from showers, sinks and kitchens.
parts.modeling_notes: Centrifuge drum visible behind a round window.

parts.name: Oxygen Generator
parts.function: Splits ice into O₂ (30 L/s LG) and H₂. Fills rooms, tanks and suits.
vfx: Frost at the intake when running
parts.modeling_notes: Ice hopper visible through a frosted window.

parts.name: Oxygen Tank
parts.function: Stores 100,000 L (LG) / 5,000 L (SG) of oxygen.
parts.modeling_notes: Blue-banded pressure cylinder (O₂ color code).

parts.name: Compact Life Support Module
parts.function: All-in-one O₂, CO₂ scrubbing and heat for small crews (up to 6). A Wren part recovered from the crashed Ark shuttle (M1.05).
parts.unlock: Salvaged in M1.05; buildable (Industrial skin) at T2.
parts.modeling_notes: Ships with two skins: Directorate (story salvage) and Industrial (buildable). Directorate skin shows scorch marks from the crash.

parts.name: Air Vent
parts.function: Joins a room to the ventilation network; can depressurize a room (a weapon against Hollows).
parts.modeling_notes: Grille on the front face. Louvers must visibly close when the vent seals (quarantine readability).

parts.name: Air Duct
parts.function: Ventilation network piece. The LG version is a crawlable maintenance duct (Crawlers and players can move through it).
parts.modeling_notes: LG: 1.2 m square crawl tunnel inside an armor shell, with access panels. SG: 0.3 m round pipe. Spores travel through these, so the vent network must be traceable in the Air View.

parts.name: CO₂ Scrubber
parts.function: Removes CO₂ from connected rooms (enough for 12 people).
parts.modeling_notes: Four swappable cartridge slots on the front; the cartridges are separate meshes.

parts.name: Spore Air Filter
parts.function: Removes spores from the air network at 12 units/min. The core defense against colony outbreaks.
emissive: Filter status: green clean / amber loaded / red clogged
parts.modeling_notes: The visible filter mesh turns green-grey as it loads (material parameter 'Load'). Matches the JSON example in bible chapter 13.

parts.name: Heater
parts.function: Warms a room. Essential on Hollowmere and in the long lunar night.
parts.modeling_notes: Wall-mounted radiator; coils glow orange with a 'Heat' parameter.

parts.name: Cooler
parts.function: Cools a room. Essential in desert daytime and near reactors.
parts.modeling_notes: Wall unit with a large fan grille.

parts.name: Atmosphere Monitor
parts.function: Shows a room's O₂, CO₂, pressure, temperature and spore count; sounds alarms.
parts.modeling_notes: Small wall screen with a strobe on top. Screen UI is rendered live, not baked.

parts.name: Workbench
parts.function: Act I crafting station: tools, melee weapons, basic components, barricades (M1.01).
parts.modeling_notes: A heavy wooden bench with a vise, pegboard of tools and a work lamp. Tools on the pegboard change as tiers unlock (swap meshes).

parts.name: Scrap Recycler
parts.function: Grinds scrap into raw iron, nickel and silicon (60% yield).
parts.modeling_notes: Converted wood-chipper look with a welded hopper.

parts.name: Basic Refinery
parts.function: Refines ore into ingots at 50% speed and 70% yield. The first refinery.
parts.modeling_notes: Tall furnace with a glowing viewport.

parts.name: Refinery
parts.function: Full-speed ore refining at 80% yield.
parts.modeling_notes: Hero industrial piece: crusher, conveyor, crucible and chimney.

parts.name: Assembler
parts.function: Builds components from ingots. The heart of every base.
parts.modeling_notes: Glass-fronted cabinet with two visible robot arms. Arms are separate PART_ meshes with pivots.

parts.name: Fabrication Bay
parts.function: Builds ship-scale parts and jump components. Large-grid welding happens inside it.
parts.modeling_notes: A room-sized hangar module. The interior is walkable.

parts.name: 3D Printer
parts.function: Prints furniture, decor and small items from bio-plastic.
parts.modeling_notes: Enclosed printer with a visible print in progress (parameter-driven build height).

parts.name: Research Station
parts.function: Turns scan data into Engineering research points. Staffed by Researchers.
parts.modeling_notes: Lab bench with monitors, microscopes and sample trays.

parts.name: Sample Analyzer
parts.function: Glovebox for Bloom samples: produces Bio research points. If damaged, it leaks spores.
parts.modeling_notes: Glovebox with two rubber gloves (cloth sim optional) and a pass-through airlock.

parts.name: Armory Bench
parts.function: Crafts firearms, ammunition, armor and turret ammo.
parts.modeling_notes: Gun-smith bench with a wall rack. Rack shows crafted weapons (swap meshes).

parts.name: Planter Box
parts.function: Soil planter for 4 crops. Needs Earth soil (or imported soil off-world) and water.
parts.modeling_notes: Raised wooden box, 0.8 m high. Crop meshes are separate growth-stage props (4 stages).

assets.variant_notes: Pallet wood and chicken wire.
Clean composite box (Domestic set).

parts.name: Hydroponics Tray
parts.function: Soil-free tray for 8 crops; needs water and light.
parts.modeling_notes: Two-tier rack. Crop props snap to 8 slots.

parts.name: Grow Light
parts.function: Full-spectrum light; lets crops grow without sunlight.
parts.modeling_notes: Ceiling fixture; the emitted light color is part of the Hydroponics look.

parts.name: Algae Farm
parts.function: Produces food paste and a little oxygen from light and CO₂.
parts.modeling_notes: Vertical glass bubble tubes with green fluid.

parts.name: Protein Vat
parts.function: Grows bland but reliable protein from organics.
parts.modeling_notes: Stainless steel vat with an inspection hatch.

parts.name: Seed Vault
parts.function: Cold storage for seeds (the Act I cargo-triage item). Seeds stored here never spoil.
parts.modeling_notes: Round vault door; racks of labeled seed tins inside.

parts.name: Livestock Pen
parts.function: Houses Tessari calves (after Veyra is healed) and other livestock: milk, fiber and happy survivors.
parts.modeling_notes: Fence, feeders, water trough and a hay-bale shelter. Sized for Tessari (2 m tall calves).

parts.name: Aquaponics Tank
parts.function: Fish tank with a grow bed on top: food plus the Fun of watching fish.
parts.modeling_notes: Glass tank with animated fish (a shared boids system), grow bed above.

parts.name: Conveyor Junction
parts.function: Six-way conveyor hub.
parts.modeling_notes: Port apertures at exact face centers (the conveyor standard). Hazard stripes around each port.

parts.name: Conveyor Tube
parts.function: Connects conveyor ports.
parts.modeling_notes: Ribbed tube with inspection windows showing items moving (animated texture).

parts.name: Conveyor Sorter
parts.function: Filters items between conveyor lines (whitelist/blacklist).
parts.modeling_notes: Junction housing with a diverter and a small screen.

parts.name: Small Cargo Container
parts.function: Storage: 15,625 L (LG) / 125 L (SG).
parts.modeling_notes: Lockable front hatch. Fill-level strip parameter 0–1.

parts.name: Large Cargo Container
parts.function: Storage: 421,875 L (LG) / 3,375 L (SG).
parts.modeling_notes: Hauler skin available (cargo-orange container ribs).

parts.name: Connector
parts.function: Docks two grids and shares their conveyor networks.
moving_parts: Magnetic collar: extends 0.2 m on lock
emissive: Status ring: yellow ready / green locked
parts.modeling_notes: The docking face must be rotationally symmetric so any two connectors mate.

parts.name: Ejector
parts.function: Throws items out of the conveyor network (dumping stone, jettisoning cargo).
parts.modeling_notes: Short barrel-shaped port on the front face.

parts.name: Collector
parts.function: Pulls in loose items and ore near its intake.
parts.modeling_notes: Funnel-shaped intake with a mesh grille.

parts.name: Atmospheric Thruster
parts.function: Electric propeller thruster; only works in atmosphere (efficiency falls with air density). 650 kN (LG) / 96 kN (SG).
moving_parts: Fan blades: spin with throttle (up to 1,800 rpm)
parts.modeling_notes: Nozzle on the front face (+X pushes the grid toward −X). Flame VFX socket at the nozzle exit. Thruster damage cone: 3× nozzle length behind the exhaust; keep it clear of the mesh.

parts.name: Large Atmospheric Thruster
parts.function: Heavy atmospheric lift. 6.5 MN (LG) / 960 kN (SG).
parts.modeling_notes: Nozzle on the front face (+X pushes the grid toward −X). Flame VFX socket at the nozzle exit. Thruster damage cone: 3× nozzle length behind the exhaust; keep it clear of the mesh.

parts.name: Ion Thruster
parts.function: Electric vacuum thruster; useless in atmosphere. 145 kN (LG) / 14.4 kN (SG).
parts.modeling_notes: Nozzle on the front face (+X pushes the grid toward −X). Flame VFX socket at the nozzle exit. Thruster damage cone: 3× nozzle length behind the exhaust; keep it clear of the mesh.

parts.name: Large Ion Thruster
parts.function: Main vacuum engine for capital ships. 4.3 MN (LG) / 172 kN (SG).
parts.modeling_notes: Nozzle on the front face (+X pushes the grid toward −X). Flame VFX socket at the nozzle exit. Thruster damage cone: 3× nozzle length behind the exhaust; keep it clear of the mesh.

parts.name: Hydrogen Thruster
parts.function: Burns hydrogen: strong everywhere (atmosphere and vacuum) but fuel-hungry. 1.1 MN (LG) / 98 kN (SG).
parts.modeling_notes: Nozzle on the front face (+X pushes the grid toward −X). Flame VFX socket at the nozzle exit. Thruster damage cone: 3× nozzle length behind the exhaust; keep it clear of the mesh.

parts.name: Large Hydrogen Thruster
parts.function: Heavy hydrogen lift for capital ships and launches. 7.2 MN (LG) / 400 kN (SG).
parts.modeling_notes: Nozzle on the front face (+X pushes the grid toward −X). Flame VFX socket at the nozzle exit. Thruster damage cone: 3× nozzle length behind the exhaust; keep it clear of the mesh.

parts.name: RCS Thruster Quad
parts.function: Four tiny cold-gas nozzles for precise docking and landing corrections (2 kN each).
parts.modeling_notes: Classic four-nozzle cluster on a small base plate.

parts.name: Gyroscope
parts.function: Provides rotation authority. Heavy ships need many.
parts.modeling_notes: Visible flywheel behind a cage on two faces.

parts.name: Wheel Suspension
parts.function: Suspension, motor and wheel for rovers. The Mule rover in M1.05 uses the SG 3×3.
parts.modeling_notes: Wheel and suspension are separate meshes. Tire tread normal map scrolls with speed; the tire bulges under load (vertex shader).

parts.name: Landing Gear
parts.function: Magnetic landing pad; locks the grid to terrain, stations or other ships.
emissive: Lock status: yellow ready / green locked
parts.modeling_notes: Flat pad on a short strut, facing the front face.

parts.name: Landing Leg
parts.function: Hydraulic landing leg: extends 1.5 m (LG) / 0.8 m (SG), self-levels on uneven ground.
parts.modeling_notes: Rig pivots: PART_Hip, PART_Strut, PART_Foot.

parts.name: Parachute Hatch
parts.function: Deploys a canopy for atmospheric descent (Earth returns, Veyra-4).
moving_parts: Canopy: cloth sim or pre-animated skeletal canopy
parts.modeling_notes: Canopy is a separate skeletal mesh SK_PRO_ParachuteCanopy (shared by both grids, scaled).

parts.name: Wing
parts.function: Generates lift in atmosphere (optional aerodynamics system).
parts.modeling_notes: Airfoil profile 0.4 m thick (LG). Leading edge on the front face.

parts.name: Elevon
parts.function: Moving control surface for pitch and roll in atmosphere.
moving_parts: Surface: hinges ±30° at the front edge
parts.modeling_notes: Matches the Wing profile at its hinge line.

parts.name: Pulse Drive
parts.function: In-system cruise drive (No Man's Sky-style): 3 s spool, 30 km/s after 15 s, so planet to planet takes 30 s – 2.5 min. Blocked below half a planet's radius; drops out automatically at planets, 20 km from stations, and for encounters.
moving_parts: Magnetic rings ×3: counter-rotate, speed with charge
parts.modeling_notes: Three stacked rings around a central core, visible through open side bays.

parts.name: Small Hydrogen Tank
parts.function: Stores 1,000,000 L (LG) / 15,000 L (SG) of hydrogen.
parts.modeling_notes: White tank with red H₂ band.

parts.name: Large Hydrogen Tank
parts.function: Stores 15,000,000 L (LG) / 500,000 L (SG) of hydrogen.
parts.modeling_notes: Spherical tank inside a square frame.

parts.name: Methalox Rocket Engine
parts.function: Kestrel's launch engine: 2.2 MN burning methane and liquid oxygen. Powers the Wren (M1.07).
parts.modeling_notes: Regeneratively cooled bell with visible plumbing. Gimbal pivot at the throat (PART_Gimbal).

parts.name: Methalox Tank
parts.function: Stores methane and LOX for rocket engines (from the Fuel Farm, M1.05).
parts.modeling_notes: Frost on the LOX half (vertex-color mask). Kestrel logo decal.

parts.name: Stage Separator
parts.function: Explosive-bolt ring that splits a grid into two stages.
moving_parts: Separation ring halves: push apart on springs
parts.modeling_notes: Thin ring (0.5 m LG). Top and bottom halves are separate meshes that become separate grids.

parts.name: Launch Clamp
parts.function: Tower arm that holds a rocket until launch. It jams in M1.07 unless you built the automated release.
parts.modeling_notes: Two assets: SM_PRO_LaunchClamp (manual lever) and the 'Automated' variant with a pneumatic actuator — the hidden engineering solution that saves Tug.

parts.name: Heat Shield
parts.function: Ablative tiles that survive re-entry heat. Collected from the Township warehouse (M1.05).
parts.modeling_notes: Black hexagonal tile pattern; char and ablation driven by a 'Burn' parameter after re-entry.

parts.name: Aerodynamic Fairing
parts.function: Smooth cover for launch stacks; reduces drag.
parts.modeling_notes: Shares the Round Slope profile.

parts.name: Rotor
parts.function: Rotating joint; the head is a separate sub-grid. Unlimited rotation.
moving_parts: Rotor head: rotates about Z, unlimited
parts.modeling_notes: Two assets per grid: the base (this part) and SM_MEC_RotorHead_*.

parts.name: Advanced Rotor
parts.function: Rotor with a hollow center: conveyors and air pass through the joint.
parts.modeling_notes: Ring bearing with a visible open core.

parts.name: Hinge
parts.function: Hinged joint (±90°) for doors, ramps, landing gear and cranes.
parts.modeling_notes: Knuckle hinge with a visible pin.

parts.name: Piston
parts.function: Linear actuator: extends 10 m (LG) / 2 m (SG).
parts.modeling_notes: Collapsed length fits the cell; each section is a separate PART_ mesh.

parts.name: Merge Block
parts.function: Magnetically merges two grids into one.
parts.modeling_notes: The merge face has a clear alignment arrow; the opposite face is plain.

parts.name: Habitat Ring Bearing
parts.function: Large-diameter spin bearing for rotating habitat rings (spin gravity). Air, people and conveyors pass through its core.
parts.modeling_notes: A walkable 2.5 m core tunnel through the bearing; ladder rungs inside.

parts.name: Flight Seat
parts.function: Open-frame seat that controls a grid. No pressurization: suits required in vacuum.
parts.modeling_notes: Joystick + throttle meshes animate with input (PART_Stick, PART_Throttle).

parts.name: Industrial Cockpit
parts.function: Pressurized two-seat cockpit with wide glass. The standard utility-ship cockpit.
parts.modeling_notes: Interior is fully modeled (first-person). Glass uses the cockpit glass material with dirt and condensation.

parts.name: Fighter Cockpit
parts.function: Single-seat pressurized cockpit for small ships.
parts.modeling_notes: HUD projection plane on the canopy (lcd socket).

parts.name: Capsule Cockpit
parts.function: The Wren crew capsule: six seats, heat-shielded base, pressurized. The survivors' ride to orbit (M1.07).
parts.modeling_notes: Hero asset. The six seats face up (launch posture). Hand-painted Kestrel mission patch and crew-signature decals.

parts.name: Passenger Seat
parts.function: Seat for survivors during flights; keeps them safe from high G.
parts.modeling_notes: 5-point harness; padded shell.

parts.name: Bridge Console
parts.function: Captain's station for capital ships; controls the grid and shows ship systems.
parts.modeling_notes: Curved desk with a holo emitter on top.

parts.name: Holo Map Table
parts.function: Hologram galaxy map for jump planning and briefings (the M2.07 star-map moment).
parts.modeling_notes: Round table; the hologram volume is 3 m tall above it.

parts.name: Guidance Computer
parts.function: Autopilot for landing, docking and orbit. One of the four Wren parts (Mission Control, M1.05).
parts.modeling_notes: Rack-mounted flight computer with a small screen and blinking status LEDs.

parts.name: Remote Control
parts.function: Lets the player (or drones' AI) control a grid remotely.
parts.modeling_notes: Small box with an antenna stub.

parts.name: Control Terminal
parts.function: Wall terminal that opens the grid's full control panel.
parts.modeling_notes: Angled wall screen with a keyboard shelf.

parts.name: Button Panel
parts.function: Four programmable buttons with labels.
parts.modeling_notes: Label strips are dynamic text surfaces.

parts.name: Timer Block
parts.function: Runs a list of actions after a delay.
parts.modeling_notes: Shares the logic-block shell with Event Controller and Sensor.

parts.name: Event Controller
parts.function: No-code logic: 'when X happens, do Y' (e.g., Hollows within 50 m → close blast doors).
parts.modeling_notes: Logic-block shell, green trim.

parts.name: Sensor
parts.function: Detects players, survivors, Hollows, ships and objects in a configurable box (up to 50 m).
parts.modeling_notes: Dome sensor on a short stalk.

parts.name: Programmable Block
parts.function: Runs sandboxed Lua scripts for advanced automation.
parts.modeling_notes: Logic-block shell, blue trim, small screen.

parts.name: LCD Panel
parts.function: Shows text, images, gauges or camera feeds.
parts.modeling_notes: Screen UVs 0–1 with a 16:9 or 1:1 aspect per variant.

parts.name: Sound Block
parts.function: Speaker for alarms, music and announcements. Loud sounds raise Attraction.
parts.modeling_notes: Horn speaker on a bracket.

parts.name: Campfire
parts.function: Warmth, basic cooking and the Act I campfire conversations. Raises Attraction at night.
parts.modeling_notes: Stone ring or cut oil-drum variant. Seat slots are logs/crates around it at 1.2 m radius.

parts.name: Radio Set
parts.function: Plays pre-outbreak music and picks up broadcasts (diegetic music). Fun +, Safety + at night.
parts.modeling_notes: Tabletop prop on a crate. Dial needle animates with the station (PART_Needle).

parts.name: Bedroll
parts.function: Sleeping bag on the floor. Rest +8/h; bad-sleep moodlet.
parts.modeling_notes: Rumpled sleeping bag with a rolled-jacket pillow. Three rumple variations (shape keys).

parts.name: Single Bed
parts.function: Rest +14/h. Personal bed (claimed by one survivor).
parts.modeling_notes: Furniture sits on the bottom face. Human scale: seat height 0.45 m, table height 0.75 m, counter 0.9 m. Blanket color from the owner's palette (material parameter).

parts.name: Double Bed
parts.function: Rest +16/h for partners; relationship bonus when shared.
parts.modeling_notes: Furniture sits on the bottom face. Human scale: seat height 0.45 m, table height 0.75 m, counter 0.9 m.

parts.name: Bunk Bed
parts.function: Two sleepers per cell. Rest +12/h; 'Cramped' moodlet in small rooms.
parts.modeling_notes: Furniture sits on the bottom face. Human scale: seat height 0.45 m, table height 0.75 m, counter 0.9 m. Ladder on one end.

parts.name: Dining Table
parts.function: Four-person table. Shared meals give +15 Social.
parts.modeling_notes: Furniture sits on the bottom face. Human scale: seat height 0.45 m, table height 0.75 m, counter 0.9 m.

parts.name: Long Dining Table
parts.function: Eight-person table. Required for the Sunday Dinner tradition (M2.03) and the final scene (M4.06).
parts.modeling_notes: Furniture sits on the bottom face. Human scale: seat height 0.45 m, table height 0.75 m, counter 0.9 m. Story furniture: the table where the game ends. Place-setting props (plates, a chipped pot of jollof) are a separate set-dressing kit.

parts.name: Chair
parts.function: Seating (Comfort +5 while seated).
parts.modeling_notes: Furniture sits on the bottom face. Human scale: seat height 0.45 m, table height 0.75 m, counter 0.9 m.

parts.name: Bench
parts.function: Two-person bench; the best seat in front of a window.
parts.modeling_notes: Furniture sits on the bottom face. Human scale: seat height 0.45 m, table height 0.75 m, counter 0.9 m.

parts.name: Couch
parts.function: Three-seat couch; Comfort +12, naps allowed.
parts.modeling_notes: Furniture sits on the bottom face. Human scale: seat height 0.45 m, table height 0.75 m, counter 0.9 m.

parts.name: Armchair
parts.function: Comfort +10; reading chair (Bookshelf bonus).
parts.modeling_notes: Furniture sits on the bottom face. Human scale: seat height 0.45 m, table height 0.75 m, counter 0.9 m.

parts.name: Kitchen Station
parts.function: Stove, counter and sink: turns ingredients into meals (Survival Ration → Homestyle → Feast).
parts.modeling_notes: Furniture sits on the bottom face. Human scale: seat height 0.45 m, table height 0.75 m, counter 0.9 m. Utensils on a rail; the pot on the stove is a swappable prop.

parts.name: Cold Storage
parts.function: Stops food spoilage.
parts.modeling_notes: Furniture sits on the bottom face. Human scale: seat height 0.45 m, table height 0.75 m, counter 0.9 m. Fridge magnets and drawings on the door (Lily's).

parts.name: Bar Counter
parts.function: Social hub: +Social and +Fun for survivors hanging out.
parts.modeling_notes: Furniture sits on the bottom face. Human scale: seat height 0.45 m, table height 0.75 m, counter 0.9 m.

parts.name: Sink
parts.function: Hygiene +20.
parts.modeling_notes: Furniture sits on the bottom face. Human scale: seat height 0.45 m, table height 0.75 m, counter 0.9 m. Mirror above (planar reflection optional).

parts.name: Toilet
parts.function: Required need-satisfier; zero-G variant works in space.
parts.modeling_notes: Furniture sits on the bottom face. Human scale: seat height 0.45 m, table height 0.75 m, counter 0.9 m. Two variants for gravity and zero-G.

parts.name: Shower
parts.function: Hygiene +60.
parts.modeling_notes: Furniture sits on the bottom face. Human scale: seat height 0.45 m, table height 0.75 m, counter 0.9 m.

parts.name: Laundry Station
parts.function: Keeps clothes clean (raises Hygiene decay time by 30%).
parts.modeling_notes: Furniture sits on the bottom face. Human scale: seat height 0.45 m, table height 0.75 m, counter 0.9 m.

parts.name: Wardrobe
parts.function: Holds a survivor's outfits; changing clothes gives a small mood bump.
parts.modeling_notes: Furniture sits on the bottom face. Human scale: seat height 0.45 m, table height 0.75 m, counter 0.9 m.

assets.variant_notes: Metal crew locker; name-tag decal slot.

parts.name: Desk
parts.function: Study, letter writing and research (+Purpose).
parts.modeling_notes: Furniture sits on the bottom face. Human scale: seat height 0.45 m, table height 0.75 m, counter 0.9 m.

parts.name: Bookshelf
parts.function: Skill books and Fun; improves reading-chair bonuses.
parts.modeling_notes: Furniture sits on the bottom face. Human scale: seat height 0.45 m, table height 0.75 m, counter 0.9 m. Book fill-level variations (shape keys or separate meshes).

parts.name: Classroom Set
parts.function: Desks and a board: children learn skills here ('School in the Stars' quest).
parts.modeling_notes: Furniture sits on the bottom face. Human scale: seat height 0.45 m, table height 0.75 m, counter 0.9 m. Chalkboard content is a dynamic texture (Lily's drawings, lessons).

parts.name: Media Wall
parts.function: Movies and shows: Fun +15/h for up to 6 viewers.
parts.modeling_notes: Wall-mounted screen with a media shelf.

parts.name: Arcade Cabinet
parts.function: Fun +20/h; competitive survivors bond (or fight) over high scores.
parts.modeling_notes: Furniture sits on the bottom face. Human scale: seat height 0.45 m, table height 0.75 m, counter 0.9 m. Salvaged 1990s cabinet with a hand-painted marquee.

parts.name: Pool Table
parts.function: Fun +18/h for 2–4 survivors.
parts.modeling_notes: Furniture sits on the bottom face. Human scale: seat height 0.45 m, table height 0.75 m, counter 0.9 m. Zero-G variant has magnetic balls (a joke line from Tug).

parts.name: Music Corner
parts.function: Instruments (guitar, keyboard, drum). Survivors with Art skill perform; performances boost everyone's mood.
parts.modeling_notes: Furniture sits on the bottom face. Human scale: seat height 0.45 m, table height 0.75 m, counter 0.9 m. Instrument meshes are separate hand props (shared with character animation).

parts.name: Gym Set
parts.function: Treadmill and weight rack: Fitness skill, Fun, and required exercise in zero-G.
parts.modeling_notes: Furniture sits on the bottom face. Human scale: seat height 0.45 m, table height 0.75 m, counter 0.9 m.

parts.name: Kids' Play Area
parts.function: Slide, soft blocks and a drawing table. Children's Fun and Safety; parents' mood +.
parts.modeling_notes: Furniture sits on the bottom face. Human scale: seat height 0.45 m, table height 0.75 m, counter 0.9 m. Drawing table shows the child's current drawing (dynamic texture: Lily's spirals).

parts.name: Chapel Set
parts.function: Altar and pews: comfort for grieving survivors; hosts funerals and weddings.
parts.modeling_notes: Furniture sits on the bottom face. Human scale: seat height 0.45 m, table height 0.75 m, counter 0.9 m. Non-denominational; symbols are swappable decals.

parts.name: Memorial Wall
parts.function: Names of the dead, added by the player. Story furniture: appears in M2.03 and scrolls in the ending (M4.06).
parts.modeling_notes: Name plates are generated text decals (up to 120 names). Leave clear space for photos and drawings people pin up.

parts.name: Rug
parts.function: Room Quality + Beauty.
parts.modeling_notes: 2 × 1.4 m floor mesh (4 cm thick) with a fringe. Three patterns.

parts.name: Potted Plant
parts.function: Beauty + Comfort; needs occasional watering.
parts.modeling_notes: Wind/air-vent sway via vertex shader.

assets.variant_notes: Bioluminescent petals (emissive).
Unlocked after M4.04: Crane's bonsai. A quiet easter egg.

parts.name: Art Frame
parts.function: Displays art made by survivors (Art skill); Beauty +.
parts.modeling_notes: Picture surface is a dynamic texture. Three frame styles.

parts.name: Floor Lamp
parts.function: Warm light; Comfort + in bedrooms and lounges.
parts.modeling_notes: Fabric shade uses translucency.

parts.name: Medicine Cabinet
parts.function: Stores medical items; first-aid refill point. The M0.02 cabinet where the player finds the first Suppressant.
parts.modeling_notes: White cabinet with a red cross; glass door with a crack state.

parts.name: Med-Pod
parts.function: Respawn point; heals and refills suit O₂ and energy. You respawn at the nearest one.
parts.modeling_notes: Upright pod; the character stands inside. The respawn animation starts inside the pod.

parts.name: Medical Bed
parts.function: Patients heal 2× faster; medics treat infection stages here.
parts.modeling_notes: Adjustable bed with a monitor arm and IV stand.

parts.name: Surgery Table
parts.function: Surgery and amputation (stops a limb bite at the source). Requires Medicine 8.
parts.modeling_notes: Steel table with an overhead surgical light arm (PART_LampArm).

parts.name: Medical Lab
parts.function: Mara's lab: crafts antivirals, medkits and stims; researches the Verdance.
parts.modeling_notes: Benches, centrifuge, fume hood and a sample fridge.

parts.name: Quarantine Cell
parts.function: Sealed room-in-a-cell with its own air supply. Holds Seeded survivors safely.
parts.modeling_notes: Glass front so the patient is visible; a speaker grille for talking.

parts.name: Bio-Scanner Gate
parts.function: Walk-through arch that detects infection (including hidden bites) and can trigger locks and alarms.
parts.modeling_notes: Arch 2.2 m tall, 1.2 m wide.

parts.name: Decon Shower
parts.function: Removes spores from suits and skin (−5% infection exposure if used within a minute); Hygiene +.
parts.modeling_notes: Yellow-and-white hazard version of the Shower.

parts.name: Cryo Pod
parts.function: Stasis for a critically infected survivor until a cure exists (Mara's M3.06 option).
parts.modeling_notes: Frosted glass lid; the occupant is visible through the frost (a mask parameter).

parts.name: Barricade
parts.function: Blocks paths and soaks Hollow damage. Hollows climb over low barricades, so height matters.
parts.modeling_notes: 1.8 m tall. Each variant has 3 damage states (intact, battered, collapsing) as separate meshes because barricades break visibly.

assets.variant_notes: Half a sedan on its side; broken glass.

parts.name: Sandbag Wall
parts.function: Cover for defenders; absorbs explosions well.
parts.modeling_notes: Individual bag shapes (6 unique bags instanced).

parts.name: Barbed Wire
parts.function: Slows Hollows by 60% and deals light damage while they push through.
parts.modeling_notes: Coiled concertina wire on X-frames. Real geometry for the coils (no alpha); keep coils under the S budget with a spline-generated low-segment wire.

parts.name: Spike Trap
parts.function: Floor spikes: damage and stagger Hollows walking over them. Wear out with use.
parts.modeling_notes: Rebar and sharpened stakes in a pallet base; 3 wear states.

parts.name: Chain-Link Fence
parts.function: See-through perimeter fence. Hollows pile against it; Brutes flatten it.
parts.modeling_notes: Masked chain-link material. Bends under load (vertex shader driven by 'Push').

parts.name: Tripwire Mine
parts.function: Explodes when a tripwire (up to 5 m) is crossed.
parts.modeling_notes: Pipe-bomb canister with a wire spool.

parts.name: Noise Decoy
parts.function: Plays loud sounds on a timer or trigger to pull hordes away from the base.
parts.modeling_notes: Alarm-clock-and-speaker contraption; the SG version is a throwable-sized box.

parts.name: Flame Trap
parts.function: Floor or wall vents that spray fire (×2 damage vs. Bloom). Burns fuel from the conveyor network.
parts.modeling_notes: Grated vent plate over nozzles; heat discoloration on the plate.

parts.name: Interior Turret
parts.function: Ceiling-mounted small-caliber turret for corridors (outbreak control).
parts.modeling_notes: Turret rig standard: PART_Base (static) → PART_Yaw (rotates about Z) → PART_Pitch (rotates about Y) → PART_Barrel (spins or recoils). Pivots on the axis lines; muzzle socket at the barrel tip.

parts.name: Gatling Turret
parts.function: The workhorse turret: 700 rpm, 800 m range. Ammo arrives through conveyors.
parts.modeling_notes: Turret rig standard: PART_Base (static) → PART_Yaw (rotates about Z) → PART_Pitch (rotates about Y) → PART_Barrel (spins or recoils). Pivots on the axis lines; muzzle socket at the barrel tip.

parts.name: Rocket Turret
parts.function: Rockets for Brutes, vehicles and ships. Splash damage.
parts.modeling_notes: Turret rig standard: PART_Base (static) → PART_Yaw (rotates about Z) → PART_Pitch (rotates about Y) → PART_Barrel (spins or recoils). Pivots on the axis lines; muzzle socket at the barrel tip.

parts.name: Flame Turret
parts.function: Short-range (30 m) flame turret: ×2 damage vs. Bloom, burns Bloom Hearts. Useless in vacuum.
parts.modeling_notes: Turret rig standard: PART_Base (static) → PART_Yaw (rotates about Z) → PART_Pitch (rotates about Y) → PART_Barrel (spins or recoils). Pivots on the axis lines; muzzle socket at the barrel tip.

parts.name: Arc Turret
parts.function: Chain lightning (3 targets). ×2 vs. drones and Sower Wardens.
parts.modeling_notes: Turret rig standard: PART_Base (static) → PART_Yaw (rotates about Z) → PART_Pitch (rotates about Y) → PART_Barrel (spins or recoils). Pivots on the axis lines; muzzle socket at the barrel tip. Tesla-coil head.

parts.name: Laser Turret
parts.function: Hitscan beam; no ammo, heavy power draw.
parts.modeling_notes: Turret rig standard: PART_Base (static) → PART_Yaw (rotates about Z) → PART_Pitch (rotates about Y) → PART_Barrel (spins or recoils). Pivots on the axis lines; muzzle socket at the barrel tip.

parts.name: Point Defense Turret
parts.function: Shoots down missiles, spore-swarms and drones.
parts.modeling_notes: Turret rig standard: PART_Base (static) → PART_Yaw (rotates about Z) → PART_Pitch (rotates about Y) → PART_Barrel (spins or recoils). Pivots on the axis lines; muzzle socket at the barrel tip. Radar dish on the yaw ring (PART_Radar spins).

parts.name: Gatling Gun
parts.function: Forward-firing gatling for fighters and gunboats.
parts.modeling_notes: Barrel along +X.

parts.name: Missile Launcher
parts.function: Four-tube forward launcher.
parts.modeling_notes: 2×2 tube grid on the front face.

parts.name: Railgun
parts.function: Charged kinetic spike (2,000 m/s). Only obtainable from exploration blueprint fragments.
parts.modeling_notes: Long twin-rail barrel with capacitor bank at the back.

parts.name: EMP Torpedo Launcher
parts.function: Disables a target's subsystems for 20 s: the first step of a boarding action.
parts.modeling_notes: Single large tube with a blue EMP warning band.

parts.name: Boarding Drill
parts.function: Drills through hulls (and the Seedship's living skin) to open a pressurized breach for a squad (M4.01).
parts.modeling_notes: Hero piece: conical cutter with a sealing skirt so the breach stays pressurized.

parts.name: Ram Prow
parts.function: Reinforced wedge for ramming and forced docking. Takes 25% of collision damage.
parts.modeling_notes: Layered armor plates with scrape marks.

parts.name: Floodlight
parts.function: 60,000 lm stadium light. Hollows avoid bright light briefly, but it raises Attraction.
parts.modeling_notes: Salvaged construction floodlight on a tripod (SCR) or pole mount (IND variant).

parts.name: Interior Light
parts.function: Room lighting; color and intensity affect mood.
parts.modeling_notes: Recessed panel light; color from the light's settings.

parts.name: Spotlight
parts.function: Directional light on a rotating mount.
parts.modeling_notes: Can be driven by sensors to track targets.

parts.name: Warning Beacon Light
parts.function: Rotating amber or red warning light for airlocks, hangars and alarms.
parts.modeling_notes: Classic rotating dome.

parts.name: Camera
parts.function: Remote view; feeds LCDs and security monitoring.
parts.modeling_notes: Security-camera housing.

parts.name: Antenna
parts.function: Broadcasts the grid and relays remote control. Range 50 km (LG) / 5 km (SG).
parts.modeling_notes: Lattice mast with dipoles; the top 20% is thin (LOD1 simplifies it to cards).

parts.name: Laser Antenna
parts.function: Point-to-point comms across unlimited range (line of sight).
parts.modeling_notes: Telescope-like head on a gimbal.

parts.name: Beacon
parts.function: Marks a grid on everyone's HUD (and on Hollow hearing: it hums).
parts.modeling_notes: Short mast with a glass dome.

parts.name: Beacon Relay
parts.function: Fast-travel endpoint between your own bases and ships (from Act II; off in Hardcore).
parts.modeling_notes: Pad with a ring arch the player steps into.

parts.name: Landing Beacon
parts.function: Autopilot landing target with pad lights (used in the M2.04 lunar landing).
parts.modeling_notes: Flat disc with four light posts.

parts.name: Ore Detector
parts.function: Marks ore deposits within 150 m (LG) / 50 m (SG).
parts.modeling_notes: Dish on a stubby mast.

parts.name: Scanner Array
parts.function: Long-range planetary scans: resource maps, Bloom coverage, life signs.
parts.modeling_notes: Parabolic dish (6 m) on a turret base.

parts.name: Signal Decoder
parts.function: Triangulates distress calls and Sower beacons: the main way to find points of interest in the open world.
parts.unlock: T1 (Red Mesa Observatory data speeds it up).
parts.modeling_notes: Rack of receivers with a big waveform screen and headphones on a hook.

parts.name: Projector
parts.function: Projects a blueprint hologram to weld into. Story blueprints use it so nobody is hard-blocked.
parts.modeling_notes: Lens dome on a squat base.

parts.name: Drone Bay
parts.function: Launches, docks and recharges construction, mining and defense drones.
parts.modeling_notes: Four drone cradles; the drones themselves are separate assets (see Equipment).

parts.name: Welder Arm
parts.function: Ship-mounted welder: builds projections and repairs.
parts.modeling_notes: Shares the multitool's weld VFX.

parts.name: Grinder Arm
parts.function: Ship-mounted grinder: salvages wrecks.
parts.modeling_notes: Circular saw head.

parts.name: Drill
parts.function: Mines voxel terrain into ore.
parts.modeling_notes: Conical head with cutter teeth; the mining sphere is 2× the head size.

parts.name: Suit Station
parts.function: Refills suit O₂, hydrogen and energy; swaps suit modules.
parts.modeling_notes: Wall unit with two hoses and three gauges (O₂ blue, H₂ red, energy yellow).

parts.name: Sower Jump Core
parts.function: Jumps the grid along a Sower jump lane: 10 s charge, an 8–12 s jump tunnel, and arrival 10–20 km from the destination system's station or beacon. Needs 50 MW to charge, cooling, and Resonance Crystal fuel. 5 min cooldown.
parts.unlock: Recovered at the Styx Wreck (M2.07); a replica can be grown at T4.
moving_parts: Nested rings ×3: rotate on different axes, speed with charge
Core petals: open during a jump
emissive: Core light (white → violet during a jump)
parts.modeling_notes: Sower modeling rules (chapter 19): no straight edges longer than 0.5 m, ribbed and shell-like surfaces, bioluminescent teal glyph emissives with a slow 'breathing' pulse. The most important hero asset in the parts list. Human mounting cradle (Industrial) is a separate mesh around it.

parts.name: Loom Node
parts.function: Grows precursor tech and Loom Serum.
parts.modeling_notes: Sower modeling rules (chapter 19): no straight edges longer than 0.5 m, ribbed and shell-like surfaces, bioluminescent teal glyph emissives with a slow 'breathing' pulse. A cradle of filaments weaving in the air above a shell basin.

parts.name: Resonance Cell
parts.function: 150 MW from Resonance Crystals. Silent (no Attraction).
parts.modeling_notes: Sower modeling rules (chapter 19): no straight edges longer than 0.5 m, ribbed and shell-like surfaces, bioluminescent teal glyph emissives with a slow 'breathing' pulse. A pulsing crystal inside a shell lattice.

parts.name: Resonance Amplifier
parts.function: +1 jump lane of range, or ×3 scanner range when attached to a Scanner Array.
parts.modeling_notes: Sower modeling rules (chapter 19): no straight edges longer than 0.5 m, ribbed and shell-like surfaces, bioluminescent teal glyph emissives with a slow 'breathing' pulse.

parts.name: Glyph-Lock Door
parts.function: Iris door that opens for a chosen glyph sequence (buildable after the first glyph set).
parts.modeling_notes: Sower modeling rules (chapter 19): no straight edges longer than 0.5 m, ribbed and shell-like surfaces, bioluminescent teal glyph emissives with a slow 'breathing' pulse.

parts.name: Living Hull
parts.function: Post-game (EXODUS): hull that grows and self-repairs 1% HP per second.
parts.modeling_notes: Sower modeling rules (chapter 19): no straight edges longer than 0.5 m, ribbed and shell-like surfaces, bioluminescent teal glyph emissives with a slow 'breathing' pulse. Must tile like armor despite organic surfaces: flat mating faces with an organic outer skin.

parts.name: Bloom-Grown Wall
parts.function: Post-game (COMMUNE): walls grown by tamed Bloom. Purify air slowly.
parts.modeling_notes: Sower modeling rules (chapter 19): no straight edges longer than 0.5 m, ribbed and shell-like surfaces, bioluminescent teal glyph emissives with a slow 'breathing' pulse. Green-and-violet Bloom surfaces instead of teal; clearly 'tamed' (flowers, not fungus).
